_comment: Synthesized response for Aqara Legacy RPC GET /app/v1.0/lumi/app/dev/query/detail?area=EU&dids=["lumi.TESTZIG0000000C"] modelled on a real T2 RGB CCT bulb capture documented in DISCOVERY_SPIKE_FINDINGS.md ('Major addendum: trait introspection endpoints' / 'dev/query/detail').
